hero.tagline: The greenest SMP server of 2026 — Folia performance, a fair economy, and a community that sticks together.

features.lead: Not just another server – every system is well thought out, works together, and stays exciting long-term.

performance.title: Folia Performance
performance.desc: Our core worlds mostly run on Folia — multi-threaded region-based ticking ensures consistently high TPS, no matter how many players are online.

economy.title: Fair Economy
economy.desc: No pay-to-win — the auction house, jobs, and marketplace are entirely driven by the community.

events.title: Regular Events
events.desc: Duels, bounty hunts, and seasonal events keep things fresh beyond regular survival.

anticheat.title: Strong Anti-Cheat
anticheat.desc: Custom-built protection systems against X-Ray, ESP, and cheats keep play fair for everyone.

crossplay.title: Java & Bedrock
crossplay.desc: Play cross-platform with friends — whether on PC, console, or mobile.

community.title: Active Community
community.desc: A dedicated team and a lively Discord community are always there for you.

wildsmp.title: WildSMP
wildsmp.description: WildSMP is the relaxed heart of our server — classic survival with a fair economy, claims and community events. PvP happens only inside the farm worlds, while the main world stays protected living and building space.

wildblock.title: WildBlock
wildblock.tagline: Our most active mode — OneBlock at its finest.
wildblock.description: WildBlock is currently the most active OneBlock mode on WildMine. Start on a single block in the middle of nowhere and unlock new phases, rewards, and challenges as your island transforms piece by piece. Everyone plays solo — there is no PvP here.

wildcity.title: WildCity
wildcity.description: WildCity will eventually become our roleplay mode, where everything takes place in one massive city — complete with its own jobs, districts, and stories. It is still a long way out: we are focusing on WildSMP and WildAttack first. You will hear it on our Discord as soon as there is anything concrete.

wildattack.title: WildAttack
wildattack.description: WildAttack is our own mode, inspired by CraftAttack and timed to the start of CraftAttack 14. Open survival with a claim system. PvP is off by default — /pvp switches it for you, and each switch starts a 12 hour cooldown.
wildattack.taglineLive: Open survival with a PvP toggle.
